description: This PHP class defines the DataGroup entity used within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties such as id, name, description, and permission flags, along with relationships to DataGroupPermission and ApiPermission entities. The class provides getter and setter methods for each property and uses Doctrine ORM annotations for database mapping.

classes.name: DataGroup
classes.description: Entity representing a data group with permissions and metadata for the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the DataGroup.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the DataGroup.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the DataGroup.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the DataGroup.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description of the DataGroup.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description of the DataGroup.

methods.name: canRead
methods.description: Determines if the DataGroup has read permission.

methods.name: setCanRead
methods.description: Sets the read permission for the DataGroup.

methods.name: canCreate
methods.description: Checks if create permission is granted.

methods.name: canUpdate
methods.description: Checks if update permission is granted.

methods.name: canDelete
methods.description: Checks if delete permission is granted.
